business_problem: Perk's sales reps were losing valuable selling time to browser-based prospect research, manual qualification, and delayed first outreach, which slowed pipeline creation and reduced the quality of early conversations.
solution_summary: Perk implemented Prospecting Agent inside Sales Cloud to remove the shadow work that was slowing its prospecting engine. Instead of forcing reps to jump across browser tabs and research tools, the agent runs continuously inside Salesforce, identifies high-fit accounts against Perk's criteria, and places them into targeted outreach cadences automatically. Perk paired that automation with a human feedback loop so sellers can validate the agent's logic, refine targeting in real time, and build trust in the system rather than treating it like a black box. Each recommended account comes with a concise rationale that explains why the prospect fits, which gives reps warmer starting points for outreach and better-prepared meetings. With research and qualification offloaded to the agent, the team spends more of the day on personalized conversations, pipeline creation, and closing work.

solution_components.name: Prospecting Agent
solution_components.role: Researches, qualifies, and routes high-fit prospects into the right sales cadences.

solution_components.name: Sales Cloud
solution_components.role: Hosts prospect data, outreach workflows, and the operating context for the sales team.

data_flow: Prospecting Agent works inside Sales Cloud to identify high-fit accounts, explain why they match Perk's criteria, and place them into targeted outreach sequences. Reps then review those insights and use the curated lead list to run more personalized calls and meetings.
business_outcome: Perk increased pipeline generation speed, improved reply and call rates, and shifted reps from manual research work to higher-value prospect conversations and personalized selling.
